core_obligations: Choose surjective etale presentations V -> Y and U -> X x_Y V with U, V schemes (proof lines 6822-6823).
Lift the finite type point x to a finite type point u of U and shrink U so that u is closed (proof lines 6824-6827).
Apply the scheme statement over the Jacobson base V to get that kappa(u)/kappa(v) is finite (proof lines 6828-6830).
Conclude that the transcendence degree of x over f(x) is 0 (proof lines 6830-6831).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if f : X -> Y is locally of finite type over a scheme S, Y is Jacobson and x is a finite type point of X, then the transcendence degree of x over f(x) is 0 (source lines 6811-6819). The proof chooses surjective etale presentations V -> Y and U -> X x_Y V, lifts x to a finite type point u of U using the surjectivity of the finite type points, shrinks U so that u is closed, and then applies the scheme statement over the Jacobson base V to conclude that kappa(u) is finite over kappa(v), which is the assertion about the transcendence degree.
